question: How many orders are in the database?
How many canceled orders are there?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'canceled';

question: What is the average product price?
Which state do the most customers come from?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT customer_state FROM customers GROUP BY customer_state ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1;

question: Which seller sold the most products?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT seller_id, COUNT(*) AS total_products_sold FROM order_items GROUP BY seller_id ORDER BY total_products_sold DESC LIMIT 1;

question: Which product category had the most sales?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT COALESCE(pt.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name) AS product_category, COUNT(*) AS total_sales FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id LEFT JOIN product_category_name_translation pt ON p.product_category_name = pt.product_category_name GROUP BY COALESCE(pt.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name) ORDER BY total_sales DESC LIMIT 1;

question: How many orders were placed in January 2017?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-01-01' AND order_purchase_timestamp < '2017-02-01';

question: What are the 5 most expensive products?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT product_id, MAX(price) AS price FROM order_items GROUP BY product_id ORDER BY price DESC LIMIT 5;

question: Which customer placed the most orders?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT c.customer_unique_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id ORDER BY order_count DESC LIMIT 1;

question: Which product generated the most revenue?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT p.product_id, SUM(oi.price) AS total_revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.product_id ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 1;
